content:
Maria: Quick ask — can we soft-hold 4x A100s in us-west2 (n1-standard demo pool) for a customer demo on Wed 09:00 PT? Vendor says their hold window closes Tue EOD.
Derek: That window is tight. I can check current pool but we're ~70% booked that slot. Any flexibility on region or time?
Maria: Prefer same region for latency demo but we can shift to Thu morning if needed. This is non-prod, short 2hr demo.
Sanjay: Cost heads-up: 4x A100 for 2hrs + burst fees ~= $1.6k. Will this come from demo budget or chargeback?
Maria: Demo budget. Procurement already drafted the PO but needs a PO# to finalize hold. vendor-sam — can you confirm how long you can hold without PO?
vendor-sam: We can soft-hold for 24hrs without PO. After that requires PO or deposit. If you confirm by Tue 18:00 PT we can keep it.
oncall-bot: [reminder] Vendor hold deadline in 18 hours — create PO or mark fallback.
Jess: Also need a Terraform PR to pin the pool allocation so autoscaler doesn't steal capacity. I can spin up a quick snippet, anyone want to review?
Kai: I can review. Ping me when PR is ready.
Maria: Here's the minimal TF patch I'm planning to open (will go into infra/gpu-pools):
```hcl
resource "redwood_gpu_reservation" "demo-usw2-a100" {
  region = "us-west2"
  sku    = "a100-40gb"
  count  = 4
  start  = "2026-03-25T16:00:00Z"
  end    = "2026-03-25T18:00:00Z"
  tags   = ["demo","customer-acme"]
}
```
Derek: Looks fine. Add `lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }` so it doesn't get accidentally torn down during canary.
Maria: Good call — will add. Also adding a short autoscaler override: `max_unreserved = 0` for that pool slot.
Sanjay: Can you post estimated billing label for chargeback (project: demo-acme)? I need that to tag the PO.
Maria: Estimate attached: ~$1.6k, labeled `project:demo-acme`. Procurement: please use PO-DEM-8892.
vendor-sam: PO-DEM-8892 received — hold extended until Tue 20:00 PT. If anything changes, DM me.
Jess: I'll open PR now: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/8342 (WIP). Please review.
Kai: Reviewing now. Small nit: align naming with existing reservations (`resv-demo-YYYYMMDD`).
Maria: Updated PR with naming and lifecycle. Thanks Kai.
Derek: One fallback option if A100s vanish — we can run a reduced demo with 2x H100 in eu-west1 and route traffic through a proxy. Latency will be worse but demo flow still valid.
Maria: Not ideal but good backup. I'll include fallback notes in demo runbook.
Sanjay: Approving demo spend. Procurement: confirm billing center and I'll sign expense.
Procurement (Maria on behalf): Billing center = `platform-demos`, cost center = `demo-acme`.
oncall-bot: Vendor hold extended by vendor-sam until Tue 20:00 PT.
Kai: PR merged. Reservation resource applied to staging infra at 14:03 PT.
Maria: Sweet — thanks all. I'll update the runbook and close the loop with customer. :thumbsup:
Derek: Nice coordination. If anything changes overnight, @oncall ping me.
Maria: Will do.
vendor-sam: Standby contact if you need same-day swap: sam@vendor.co or +1-555-0123.
Jess: Closing checklist: PR merged, PO issued, reservation applied, runbook updated. Good to go.
Maria: End-to-end done. Thanks everyone! :party_popper:
